exposure: Combined Pelvic Floor Exercises (PFE) and abdominal muscle exercises
outcome: Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI) symptoms (measured by QUID score)
cohort: The study participants were 26 women diagnosed with Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI), recruited via purposive sampling from an outpatient department.
finding: An eight-week program combining abdominal muscle exercises with Pelvic Floor Exercises resulted in better improvement in SUI symptoms and PFM strength compared to Pelvic Floor Exercises alone.
